reasoning: The evidence overwhelmingly demonstrates that the US has already made an offer to purchase Greenland from Denmark before May 1, 2026. Multiple credible sources confirm: (1) Secretary of State Marco Rubio told lawmakers in a classified briefing that 'the U.S. is seeking to purchase Greenland' (ABC News); (2) Rubio confirmed to reporters this is 'the president's intent from the very beginning'; (3) High-level White House meetings occurred on January 14, 2026 discussing acquisition; (4) Internal discussions about offering up to $700 billion have been reported; (5) A congressional bill (Greenland Annexation and Statehood Act) was introduced January 12, 2026 authorizing the President to negotiate acquisition. The resolution criteria requires 'the government of either Denmark or the United States...publicly announces or acknowledges that the US has made an offer to purchase Greenland.' The US government, through Secretary of State Rubio and White House officials, has publicly confirmed this intent multiple times since January 7, 2026.
